acpira.conf.agents.deprecated: Agent launch configuration is now managed by Acpira in agents.json on the agent host. Open it from Acpira Settings. Local legacy values are imported once; Remote connections do not import IDE agent settings.
acpira.cmd.openPreview: Open Local Page in Acpira Browser
acpira.conf.sessionScope: Which sessions the list shows: those opened in this workspace folder, or every session on this machine
acpira.conf.sessionScope.workspace: Sessions opened in the current workspace folder
acpira.conf.sessionScope.all: Every session on this machine, tagged with its project
acpira.conf.agents: Add custom ACP agents: `{ "<id>": { "name": "display name", "command": "executable", "args": ["..."], "login": "login command", "install": { "command": "install line", "docs": "URL" } } }`
acpira.conf.agents.subagents: Advertise subagent support to this agent at initialize (default true); set false for an agent that rejects unknown client capabilities.
acpira.conf.agents.terminalAuth: Advertise terminal-style sign-in support to this agent at initialize (default true); set false for an agent whose ACP process ignores a login written from a terminal.
acpira.conf.sessionListPosition: Session list position inside Acpira: collapsed, left, or right. Narrow panels use a drawer.
acpira.conf.shareEditorSelection: Offer what is selected in the editor or in another tool to the chat: it shows as a chip beside the mode and goes out with the next message
